constructor() sets name/symbol/decimals/_totalSupply and mints full supply to msg.sender
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view returns balances[tokenOwner]
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]

transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moves balances and reduces allowance without an explicit allowance check
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) returns a+b with overflow require
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) returns a-b with underflow require
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) returns a*b with overflow require
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) returns a/b with b>0 require

balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transfer/transferFrom

c = a / b with require(b > 0) arithmetic in safeDiv
